title: pysystemtrade / Carver's diversified trend-following system
economic_hypothesis: the system targets a modest risk-adjusted return from diversified futures trend following, not a per-trade edge
market: for this project: the system trades leveraged futures across ~100 markets by default
assets: a configured futures instrument list; no crypto spot sleeve by default
entry_rules: in the engine: EWMAC/breakout/carry forecast combination above the configured threshold
exit_rules: via position sizing and forecast scaling rather than a price stop; no target is used; not applicable; forecast decay/sign change
risk_rules: volatility targeting with forecast scaling and a fixed risk budget; daily rebalance, no session constraint
parameters: in the engine's configuration files and the book
claimed_period: the book and blog cover multiple decades of futures data
claimed_metrics: at this read level (book results, not captured here)
transaction_cost_model: the engine carries explicit cost assumptions
required_data: user-supplied futures data (a free sample source is included with the engine)
external_results: a long-lived open-source implementation of a published system with decades of public discussion
counter_evidence: reproducing it exactly requires a futures account, margin and 100 markets — none of which this project can trade
keeping only the trend component on BTC spot would be a new strategy, and the mission forbids relabelling our own design as an external replication
the project's admission cost is a 23.791 bps round trip, and the source declares no cost model (the engine carries explicit cost assumptions)
found in the RFC-035S2 strategy-first search; no local backtest influenced this record
replication_difficulty: NOT_COMPARABLE: the system's edge is a diversified risk premium measured over years, while this project's admission bar is a 23.791 bps round trip on spot crypto trades
evidence_quality: E3 — a long-lived open-source implementation of a published system with decades of public discussion
selection_bias_risk: MEDIUM (the search was run with knowledge of 2024-2025 published results)
gaps_to_p0: the instrument class is wrong for this runtime (futures, leverage, shorting)
a spot-crypto long/cash version would be our own design, not this external strategy
